server_host.description: Network interface address for the main server to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0').

server_port.description: TCP port for the main Balboa server (GraphQL + frontend).

type.description: Storage backend type. SQLite for single-node, Postgres for distributed or high-scale.

path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (used when `type: sqlite`).

pool_size.description: PostgreSQL connection pool size (used when `type: postgres`).

max_open_conns.description: Maximum open connections to the database.

max_idle_conns.description: Maximum idle connections retained in the pool.

enabled.description: Enable authentication for GraphQL API endpoints.

users.description: List of user credentials (required for 'basic' auth).

password_hash.description: Pre-hashed password (e.g., bcrypt, SHA256). Do not store plaintext.

jwt_secret.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens (required for 'jwt' auth).

jwt_expiry_seconds.description: JWT token validity duration in seconds (default: 24h).

enabled.description: Enable serving the web-based query frontend.

static_dir.description: Path to directory containing frontend static assets (HTML, JS, CSS).

cors_origins.description: List of allowed CORS origins (e.g., 'https://example.com'). Empty list = no CORS restrictions.

output.description: Log destination: standard streams or file path.

enabled.description: Enable rate limiting on GraphQL and API endpoints.

requests_per_second.description: Average rate limit (requests per second) per client/IP.

burst_size.description: Maximum burst of requests allowed in a short window.

path.description: HTTP path for the GraphQL endpoint.

playground_enabled.description: Enable the GraphQL Playground debug UI (not for production).

enabled.description: Enable Passive DNS ingestion listener (usually UDP port 53).

listen_host.description: Local IP to bind the DNS ingestion listener (restrict to loopback for security).

listen_port.description: UDP port for DNS queries (typically 53; requires elevated privileges if <1024).

max_record_size.description: Maximum DNS packet size (in bytes) accepted during ingestion (RFC 1035-compliant).

min_ttl.description: Minimum TTL (in seconds) enforced for ingested records (discards ultra-low TTL).

max_cname_chain_depth.description: Maximum CNAME/DNAME chain depth to follow during record resolution.

allowed_source_subnets.description: List of allowed source subnets (CIDR) permitted to submit DNS queries for ingestion.

upstream_resolvers.description: Upstream DNS resolvers (host:port) used for recursive resolution of ingested queries.

dir.description: Directory where backup files are stored.

format.description: Backup format: SQL dump, or JSON/NDJSON (for ingestion replay).

schedule_cron.description: Cron expression for backup scheduling (e.g., '0 2 * * *' = daily at 02:00).

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain backup files before auto-deletion.
